answer: The protocol's tundra of collateral lockup forces each validator to stake proportionally to the square of its weight, imposing quadratic erosion that sets slashing at 1.5x bonded stake. Marginal attack cost grows as the cube of total stake, so a Sybil cluster of n identities faces a super-linear n^3 outlay whose cost delta dwarfs any extractable value. A zero-knowledge verifiable delay secures basalt finality, yielding negative expected utility and a robust Nash equilibrium for honest nodes.
